server_identifier.description: Unique identifier for this collaborative server instance, used in session negotiation.

listen_host.description: IP address or hostname the server binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

listen_port.description: TCP port the server listens on for client connections.

ssl_cert.description: Absolute path to the SSL/TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

ssl_key.description: Absolute path to the SSL/TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

gnutls_priority.description: GnuTLS priority string controlling cipher suites and protocol version. Adjust for security vs compatibility.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

allow_anonymous.description: Allow guests to connect without authentication.

anonymous_role.description: Default role assigned to anonymous users (e.g., 'reader' or 'writer').

share_path.description: Directory path where collaborative documents are stored and served from.

auto_save.description: Enable automatic saving of shared documents on change.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Use '-' to log to standard output (e.g., for systemd journal).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS for secure connections. Requires ssl_cert and ssl_key.

pid_file.description: Path to PID file. Must be writable by the infinoted process.

websocket_enabled.description: Enable WebSockets support for real-time sync (required by some clients like Gobby).

auth_backend.description: Authentication method: 'none' (no auth), 'simple' (user/password file), or 'ldap' (LDAP server).

simple_auth_users.description: List of users for simple authentication. Only used when auth_backend = simple.

password_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the password (e.g., from 'echo -n 'pass' | sha256sum'). Avoid plain text.

ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URI (e.g., ldap://host:port or ldaps:// for secure).

ldap_base.description: Base DN for user searches in the LDAP directory.

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN to bind as when querying LDAP (optional; for anonymous bind leave empty).

ldap_user_filter.description: LDAP filter for user lookup; '%u' is replaced by the username.

session_timeout.description: Maximum session duration in seconds. 0 = no timeout.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before automatically disconnecting a client.
